# Releasing

Source: https://github.com/marshmallow-code/marshmallow/blob/dev/RELEASING.md

# Releasing

1. Bump version in `pyproject.toml` and update the changelog
   with today's date.
2. Run `uv sync`
3. Commit: `git commit -m "Bump version and update changelog"`
4. Tag the commit: `git tag x.y.z`
5. Push: `git push --tags origin dev`. CI will take care of the
   PyPI release.

---

# Security Contact Information

Source: https://github.com/marshmallow-code/marshmallow/blob/dev/SECURITY.md

# Security Contact Information

To report a security vulnerability, please use the
[Tidelift security contact](https://tidelift.com/security).
Tidelift will coordinate the fix and disclosure.
